name: SMEEF competitive grant rounds
summary: Flexible Scottish fund for marine and coastal restoration projects, from planting and propagation to survey and community engagement, run as competitive rounds with criteria set for each round.

geography.label: UK-based applicants; projects delivered in Scotland

eligibility.rule: Applicant is a constituted group or organisation
Main applicant is not a for-profit company, unless it is a minority consortium partner
Project is not a statutory function
Project is not political activity or a campaign
Project activities have not already started
Project focuses on the marine and coastal environment

applicant_types.quote: SMEEF funds constituted groups and organisations. For-profit organisations are welcome to apply to SMEEF, but they should form part of a consortium application with a non-profit or community group.

geography.quote: The applicant(s) must be based in the UK and all projects must be delivered in Scotland.

access.quote: At the moment we run competitive grant rounds and make targeted interventions as funds allow.

consortium_required.quote: For-profit organisations are welcome to apply to SMEEF, but they should form part of a consortium application with a non-profit or community group.

eligibility.quote: SMEEF funds constituted groups and organisations.
The main applicant cannot be a for profit company, however they can make up a minority interest of a consortium bid
SMEEF is unable to fund statutory functions
SMEEF will not fund political activity or campaigns
We cannot pay for activities that have already started.
Projects must focus on the marine and coastal environment.
